h1: Benin tourist visa from the UK
intro: Planning a holiday or a visit to family or friends in Benin? This page explains the Benin tourist visa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and enough money for your stay

sections.heading: Do you need a Benin tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Benin, and can apply online for an eVisa before travelling.

sections.heading: What a Benin tourist visa covers
sections.text: A Benin tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Benin. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Benin business visa](/benin-business-visa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually apply the same way. The eVisa is linked to your passport, so travel on the passport you used to apply.

sections.heading: Benin tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Benin tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Benin.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Benin tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Benin tourist visa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Benin on a Benin tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does a Benin tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
